description: For every GTFS stop (edge) in tiers bern and ring: the routes calling there and where they go next. trip_days = scheduled trips x operating days in the feed. bearing = initial great-circle bearing from this stop coordinate to the next stop coordinate, weighted by trip_days (bearing_concentration 1 = all departures leave the same way, near 0 = opposite ways).
source: derived from GTFS stop_times.txt and stops.txt (gtfs_fp2026_20261118.zip)
inferred_how: computed from consecutive stop_times of trips serving Bern; straight-line bearings, not track or road geometry
